verified: CrowdStrike has agreed to acquire Zscaler in an all-stock transaction that values the zero-trust security provider at about $43.9 billion, according to statements reported by CNBC, Bloomberg and The Information; CNBC reported the deal is expected to close in the second half of CrowdStrike's fiscal 2028, and CrowdStrike said the combination would better equip customers to use AI agents.
unconfirmed: The $44 billion figure in the headline is a rounding of the ~$43.9 billion stated deal value, and the sources give no exchange ratio, regulatory-review status, breakup terms, or financing detail. Neither company's own press release is in the available reporting, and no independent assessment of the price or of the AI-agent rationale has been published, so the strategic justification rests on CrowdStrike's word.
每股收购价、双方董事会是否已批准、Zscaler 股东大会与监管审批的时间表均未在报道中披露；CrowdStrike 所称交易将“让客户更好地使用 AI 智能体”属于公司给出的理由，尚无独立验证。

titles.en: CrowdStrike to acquire Zscaler for $44B to bolster AI agent security
titles.zh: CrowdStrike 拟以 440 亿美元收购 Zscaler，TechCrunch 报道
